menu.title: Wear OS Settings
menu.home_config_desc: Choose up to 4 devices to display in the smartwatch widget (Tile), customizing their quick action and short label.

home_config.title: Widget Configuration
home_config.subtitle: Configure the 4 devices for the 2x2 quick action widget (Tile) on Wear OS. Customize the primary action and display name for each device. If none are selected, the widget falls back to your first 4 Favorites.
